form.label: OTShield - Live
form.description: Live OT deception and anomaly telemetry from OTShield, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK for ICS. Auto-refreshes every 10s.

search.query: index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "CEF:0\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|(?<sig>[^|]*)\|" | eval is_breach=if(sig=="OT-SIEM-TEST",0,1) | search is_breach=1 | stats count
index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "otRiskScore=(?<risk>[0-9.]+)" | stats max(risk) as m | eval m=coalesce(round(m,0),0)
index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "CEF:0\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|(?<sev>[^|]*)\|" | eval sev=tonumber(sev) | where sev>=8 | stats count
index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "otMitreTechnique=(?<technique>.+?)(?=\s+[a-zA-Z]+=|$)" | where isnotnull(technique) | stats dc(technique)

panel.title: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS - kill-chain coverage (observed on the deception fabric)

search.query: index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "otMitreTactic=(?<tactic>.+?)(?=\s+[a-zA-Z]+=|$)" | rex "otMitreTechnique=(?<technique>.+?)(?=\s+[a-zA-Z]+=|$)" | rex "otRiskScore=(?<risk>[0-9.]+)" | where isnotnull(tactic) | stats count as Events, dc(technique) as Techniques, max(risk) as Risk by tactic | append [| makeresults | eval tactic="Initial Access,Execution,Persistence,Privilege Escalation,Evasion,Discovery,Lateral Movement,Collection,Command and Control,Inhibit Response Function,Impair Process Control,Impact" | makemv delim="," tactic | mvexpand tactic | eval Events=0, Techniques=0, Risk=0] | stats sum(Events) as Events, max(Techniques) as Techniques, max(Risk) as Risk by tactic | eval Risk=if(Risk=0,null(),round(Risk,0)) | eval order=case(tactic=="Initial Access",1,tactic=="Execution",2,tactic=="Persistence",3,tactic=="Privilege Escalation",4,tactic=="Evasion",5,tactic=="Discovery",6,tactic=="Lateral Movement",7,tactic=="Collection",8,tactic=="Command and Control",9,tactic=="Inhibit Response Function",10,tactic=="Impair Process Control",11,tactic=="Impact",12,true(),13) | sort order | fields - order | rename tactic as "ATT&CK for ICS Tactic"
index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "otMitreTechnique=(?<technique>.+?)(?=\s+[a-zA-Z]+=|$)" | where isnotnull(technique) | stats count as Events by technique | sort -Events

index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "CEF:0\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|(?<sev>[^|]*)\|" | eval sev=tonumber(sev) | eval Severity=case(sev>=9,"CRITICAL",sev>=7,"HIGH",sev>=4,"MEDIUM",true(),"LOW") | stats count by Severity

chart.title: OT events over time by type

search.query: index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "CEF:0\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|(?<sig>[^|]*)\|" | timechart span=1m count by sig

index=main sourcetype=cef | rex "CEF:0\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|(?<sig>[^|]*)\|(?<cname>[^|]*)\|(?<sev>[^|]*)\|" | rex "\bsrc=(?<src>\S+)" | rex "\bproto=(?<proto>\S+)" | rex "\bdhost=(?<dhost>.+?)(?=\s+[a-zA-Z]+=|$)" | rex "otMitreTactic=(?<tactic>.+?)(?=\s+[a-zA-Z]+=|$)" | rex "otMitreTechnique=(?<technique>.+?)(?=\s+[a-zA-Z]+=|$)" | rex "otRiskScore=(?<risk>[0-9.]+)" | eval sev=tonumber(sev) | eval Severity=case(sev>=9,"CRITICAL",sev>=7,"HIGH",sev>=4,"MEDIUM",true(),"LOW") | sort -_time | table _time sig cname Severity src dhost proto tactic technique risk | rename sig as "Signature", cname as "Event", src as "Source IP", dhost as "Target asset", proto as "Protocol", tactic as "MITRE tactic", technique as "MITRE technique", risk as "Risk"
